subject: Mobile Development
subcategory: Famous Apps That Changed the World
title: Candy Crush: The Addictive Loop
description: One-minute skill: Candy Crush: The Addictive Loop.

hook.text: A simple puzzle game about matching candy made over $20 billion in lifetime revenue.

buildup.text: Candy Crush Saga used free-to-play mechanics with timed lives and in-app purchases.

discovery.text: King's addictive loop — play, fail, wait or pay — hooked hundreds of millions of players.

twist.text: Activision Blizzard bought King for $5.9 billion, valuing a candy game above most studios.

climax.text: Candy Crush proved casual mobile games could generate more revenue than AAA console titles.

punchline.text: Matching candy earns more than blockbuster games.

quiz.question: What monetization model does Candy Crush use?
options: Free-to-play with timed lives and in-app purchases
